<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="brandGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="6" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.12"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="21" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="326" y1="16" x2="326" y2="21" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="330" y1="14" x2="330" y2="21" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="334" y1="12" x2="334" y2="21" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="348" cy="17" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="348" y1="17" x2="354" y2="11" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="363" y="11" width="20" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="365" y="13" width="15" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="384" y="14" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="31,59 22,68 31,77" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="195" y="72" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="1" fill="#4A4A4A">SETUP</text>
    <text x="365" y="72" text-anchor="end" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">2 OF 6</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Progress indicator -->
  <g>
    <rect x="22" y="91" width="346" height="5" rx="3" fill="#EAEDF1"/>
    <rect x="22" y="91" width="115" height="5" rx="3" fill="url(#brandGradient)"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Question area -->
  <g>
    <text x="22" y="150" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="26" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Are you flexible about</text>
    <text x="22" y="184" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="26" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">NSFW content?</text>
    <text x="22" y="218" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Choose the setting that feels right for you.</text>
    <text x="22" y="239" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="300" fill="#939393">You can change this anytime in your preferences.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Option cards -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="22" y="272" width="346" height="104" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="52" cy="309" r="18" fill="#F5F7FA" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="52" y="315" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#4A4A4A">Y</text>
    <text x="84" y="306" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#4A4A4A">YES</text>
    <text x="84" y="330" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">I’m open to seeing NSFW content.</text>
    <circle cx="340" cy="324" r="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="22" y="394" width="346" height="104" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="52" cy="431" r="18" fill="#F5F7FA" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="52" y="437" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#4A4A4A">N</text>
    <text x="84" y="428" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#4A4A4A">NO</text>
    <text x="84" y="452" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Keep my experience free from NSFW content.</text>
    <circle cx="340" cy="446" r="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Information card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="22" y="528" width="346" height="66" rx="12" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
    <circle cx="47" cy="560" r="12" fill="#EA5D6B"/>
    <text x="47" y="565" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">i</text>
    <text x="70" y="555" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Your choice helps personalize</text>
    <text x="70" y="574" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">what you see and who sees you.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Disabled continue button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="22" y="622" width="346" height="44" rx="22" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <text x="195" y="649" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.5" fill="#939393">CONTINUE</text>
  </g>

  <text x="195" y="699" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="300" fill="#939393">Select an option to continue</text>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <line x1="0" y1="752" x2="390" y2="752" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
    <g>
      <polygon points="37,777 48,768 59,777 59,790 37,790" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <polyline points="34,777 48,765 62,777" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="48" y="810" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">DISCOVER</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="132" cy="778" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <polyline points="127,778 131,782 138,774" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="132" y="810" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">LIKES</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="207" y="769" width="23" height="17" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <polygon points="213,786 211,792 219,786" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <circle cx="214" cy="777" r="1.5" fill="#939393"/>
      <circle cx="222" cy="777" r="1.5" fill="#939393"/>
      <text x="218" y="810" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">CHATS</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="330" cy="775" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <ellipse cx="330" cy="789" rx="13" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="330" y="810" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#FE3675">PROFILE</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Home indicator -->
  <rect x="145" y="829" width="100" height="4" rx="2" fill="#000000"/>
</svg>
